name: 01-photos
note: Add photos and group them by item.

name: 02-grouped
note: Group related photos, then Generate 2 drafts once.

name: 03-preparing
note: Generation begins on the overview, without automatic navigation.

name: 04-review-ready
note: The first item offers Review immediately while the next prepares.

name: 05-review-with-progress
note: Review item 1 while item 2 prepares. Next ready is disabled until a result exists.

name: 06-copy-early
note: Copy immediately. The item remains a draft until explicitly marked as listed.

name: 07-completes-in-place
note: Completion preserves the seller edits and current item.

name: 08-next-ready
note: The seller chooses Next ready to review the second result.

name: 09-batch-ready
note: Both rows offer Review, with one completion count and no redundant grouping panel.

name: 10-mark-listed
note: After explicit Mark as listed, the next ready item opens and Back to batch remains available.

name: 11-single-after-batch
note: Starting a new single item still offers Generate, without old batch progress.

name: 12-small-phone
note: 320px check: review actions and batch progress fit without horizontal scrolling.

name: 13-tablet
note: Tablet layout keeps the same compact review and progress.

name: 14-desktop
note: Desktop web review uses the existing layout, with one progress panel.

name: 15-progress-scrolled
note: Long-description stress check: progress stays below the sticky header and clear of the bottom action.
